The '''Nigkoe Detention Facility''' was a [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Prison/Legends|detention center]] on [[Felucia/Legends|Felucia]]. [[Barriss Offee/Legends|Barriss Offee]] and [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Zonder/Legends|Zonder]] were held hostage here until [[Aayla Secura/Legends|Aayla Secura]] and [[Clone Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Bly]] rescued them and took out most of the staff.
